notes.title: Guilded Hearts: New BL Visual Novel!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/e651c7a8d52d3015d5fc7044dc76c5455025283b.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Demo + Kickstarter Coming FALL 2022![/h2][/b]
🧡 [url=https://discord.com/invite/p3pM8rj]Join the Discord Server[/url]
🧡 [url=https://twitter.com/gallium_games]Follow Gallium Games on Twitter[/url]
🧡 [url=https://blog.argentgames.co/]Development Blog[/url]

[hr]
[h1]A new BxB visual novel from Gallium Games![/h1]
We're super excited to announce our newest VN project: [b]Guilded Hearts![/b]

It's a [b]slice-of-life/romance BL visual novel (optional 18+ content)[/b] centered around a fantasy MMO. Customize your [b]MC's name/appearance and romance four potential fellow players![/b]

[h1]Read more about Guilded Hearts + add it to your wishlist![/h1]
Check out GH's Steam page below and wishlist it to be notified upon release! (Wishlists help out our visibility immensely <3)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2105700/Guilded_Hearts

notes.title: New VN RELEASED: The Hepatica Spring!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/c088f07223a2765ed7f7e14b9559c90e6fec6c1a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Our latest VN is now released![/h1]
[b]The Hepatica Spring[/b] is a Nordic fairytale-inspired, fluffy fantasy story full of magic! It's a lighthearted romp with no bad endings--just relax and enjoy the adventure!
[list][*] [b]Genre:[/b] Visual Novel, modern fantasy, comedy, (optional) romance
[*] [b]Routes:[/b] 3 (romantic or friendship/platonic)
[*] [b]Length:[/b] ~50,000 words
[*] [b]Additional Features:[/b]
    - Name the main character
    - Play as any gender you please
    - Pet the best drog (dragon-dog) of all time: Digby![/list]
Who will you dance with this Midsummer's eve? 💙

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1883990/The_Hepatica_Spring
